Location Details: United States, Remote

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.

This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings.

This position is not eligible to be performed in Alaska, Mississippi, North Dakota, or the Virgin Islands.

GoDaddy is not currently considering candidates for this role in California, Seattle, or NYC.

Join our team

GoDaddy is in the middle of a significant product transformation. Roughly two-thirds of our product development work now involves artificial intelligence, and the questions our product teams need answered have changed fundamentally. We're no longer just evaluating interfaces. But the dynamic human-AI systems: whether they're useful, trustworthy, recoverable, and understood by the customers who depend on them.

We are seeking a Director UX Research for the Product Experience group to join our team! Partnering directly with collaborators across business functions, your mandate is twofold. Set and uphold the research standard for user experience professionals conducting generative and iterative research. Support partner teams doing small-batch testing. Additionally, personally lead strategic and AI evaluation work that demands dedicated research depth.

This is not a role for someone who wants to manage a research queue. It's for a leader who sees research as both a customer intelligence capability and a product quality system and who knows how to operate both at the speed modern product development demands. GoDaddy's UX designers are capable practitioners who handle a significant volume of discovery and evaluative research. The research team's value is highest where that work can't go: complex AI experience evaluation, cross-product synthesis, foundational understanding of customer behavior, and the strategic questions that require dedicated depth!

What you'll get to do...

Research Strategy and Prioritization

• Define a research agenda that sits ahead of product roadmaps, not behind them — identifying the questions that need to be answered before key product and architectural decisions are made

• Partner with Product, Build, and senior Engineering management to align research priorities against product risk, customer impact, and AI complexity

• Distinguish between what the research team should own directly and what the broader UX community can handle with the right support

• Help GoDaddy continue to mature in how it uses AI to test, validate, and accelerate insight generation — developing a point of view on where AI-assisted methods are appropriate and where human judgment remains essential

• Represent research as a key influence on product direction, not a validation step after building

AI Evaluation and Emerging Experience Research

• Lead research into the human dimensions of GoDaddy's AI products: how customers understand, trust, accurately address, adapt to, and recover from experiences involving artificial intelligence

• Partner on evaluation frameworks for agentic and AI-assisted features — contributing methodological expertise on trust, control, edge cases, and live-product monitoring — before and after launch

• Bring leadership to research questions that don't have established playbooks: prompt and workflow analysis, human-in-the-loop testing, behavioral data interpretation in AI contexts

• Stay current on AI-experience research methods and bring that knowledge into the team and the wider build group

Standards, Enablement, and Research Craft

• Set the research quality bar for the entire Product UX organization. This includes UX designers conducting generative and iterative research, as well as partner teams running their own small-batch testing.

• Refine existing frameworks, guardrails, and playbooks so that designers and partner teams can run clean discovery: when directional research is enough, when it isn't, how to synthesize and share findings, so they compound across the org

• Lead all aspects of the continued development of UX designers running research — building research craft, raising quality standards, and driving the integration of AI research tools and methodologies into how the broader design organization works

• Ensure shared infrastructure remains current and usable: repositories, taxonomies, participant panels, consent and data governance standards, AI-assisted workflows

Team Leadership and Development

• Lead, mentor, and develop a research team that includes both existing researchers and new hires

• Build toward complementary strengths across the team: generative and assessment-focused research, quantitative and mixed-methods capability, AI evaluation proficiency, and research operations

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Network Economics
jobs.sourceName: Jobicy: latest jobs
jobs.description:
Who are we and why should you join us?

BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

As the Principal Product Manager, Network Economics at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We deeply invest in our team’s well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand. At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way.

What are we looking for?

BetterHelp is looking for a principal-level individual contributor to own therapist compensation and incentives: the economic mechanisms that determine whether a client who needs care can find the right therapist, in their state, under their plan, as soon as possible. We match hundreds of thousands of clients to licensed therapists across every state and a growing set of insurance plans. How quickly that match happens comes down to the strength, size, and variety of our therapist population, and how quickly we can shift it toward the plans and states where clients are waiting.

This individual will own the mechanisms that drive that supply pool, compensation rates, structure, and incentives, as a product and be accountable for the business outcome, not just the shipped feature. That means close collaboration with cross functional stakeholders, deriving defensible answers to how much therapist capacity we actually need and where, and experiments that tell us how the network responds when we change what it earns.

It’s an exciting opportunity for someone who is deeply analytical and does their best work in ambiguity: able to take a problem where the data is incomplete and the stakeholders don’t yet agree, and still reach an effective outcome with the organization behind it. The problems here sit where product, economics, and clinical operations meet, all while making a difference in the lives of people seeking mental health care.

What will you do?

• Own the incentive system that moves therapist availability toward where clients actually need it, designed to be targeted, measurable, and reversible

• Own the structure and clarity of the compensation model itself: what a therapist can predict about their earnings, and what the model rewards them for

• Define what “well supplied” means for a network like ours, and build the tools and features that close the gap

• Build a compelling and sustainable earnings proposition for therapists, and use controlled rollouts and rigorous measurement to learn what actually moves availability before we commit to it, all within the realities of a licensed, independent clinical workforce

• Incentivize the specific behaviors that create client access, including therapist availability, match acceptance, and continuity of care

• Analyze and quantify the impact of every change we make, then draw conclusions and plan next steps based on actual data

• Partner closely with matching, eligibility, member experience, therapist experience, and provider acquisition. Your systems and theirs depend on each other

• Work cross-functionally with finance, clinical, legal, marketing, data science, and operations, who have a stake in nearly everything this role touches, to get a change designed, approved, launched, and measured

• Participate in setting the strategy and long-term direction for the organization, both within and beyond the context of product

• Own KPI’s and be obsessed about them

• In a nutshell: Diagnose, model, design, test, measure, decide, systematize

What will you NOT do?

• You will NOT worry about "runway", "cash left", or "how much time we have until the next round". We have the startup DNA but we're fully backed and funded, all the way to success.

• You will NOT be confined to your "job". You will get involved in product, marketing, business strategy, and almost everything we do.

• You will NOT be bogged down by office politics, ego, or bad attitude. Only positive, pleasure-to-work-with people are allowed here!

• You will NOT get yourself burned out. We work hard but we believe in maintaining a sustainable work/life balance. Really.

Can I work remotely?

Yes. We operate on PST and candidates in any time zone are welcome

Xenon Pharmaceuticals ( NASDAQ:XENE ) is a neuroscience-focused biopharmaceutical company dedicated to drug discovery, clinical development, and commercialization of life-changing therapeutics for patients in need. We are looking for great people who thrive in a respectful, collaborative, inclusive, and productive culture to join the Xenon team.

What We Do:

We are advancing an exciting product pipeline to address indications with high unmet medical need, including epilepsy, depression and pain. Our Phase 3 azetukalner program represents the most advanced, clinically validated potassium channel modulator in late-stage clinical development for multiple indications. In March 2026, we announced positive topline data from our Phase 3 X-TOLE2 study of azetukalner in focal onset seizures (FOS), and we submitted a New Drug Application to the Food and Drug Administration in the third quarter of 2026. Our Phase 3 epilepsy program also includes a second FOS study, X-TOLE3, which would support regulatory submissions outside the U.S., and the X-ACKT study in primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures, which would support regulatory submissions for an additional epilepsy indication. We also have multiple Phase 3 azetukalner clinical trials underway in major depressive disorder (MDD) and bipolar depression (BPD), based on topline data from our Phase 2 X-NOVA clinical trial. In addition, we are proud of our strong heritage in human genetics, deep understanding of ion channel biology, and expertise in novel chemistries to enable potent, selective ion channel targeting. We continue to advance an early-stage pipeline of novel therapeutic candidates, including Phase 1 studies for XEN1701 and XEN1720 (targeting Nav1.7) and XEN1120 (targeting Kv7), which are being developed for pain. Backed by a strong balance sheet to support our growth plans, we continue to build a fully integrated, premier neuroscience company with strong discovery, clinical development, corporate, and commercial operations.

You'll work alongside our creative strategists, creative teams and product team, using evidence to turn great ideas into results for global brands.

What You'll Do

• Bring performance data and past results into every brief, so strategy starts from what people actually do.

• Lead performance-focused projects, finding the opportunity in the data and briefing creative teams.

• Turn campaign ideas into in-market plans across channels, formats and audiences.

• Design testing roadmaps and measurement frameworks, and set up tests and tracking.

• Analyse creative performance to show what's working, what isn't and why.

• Optimise creative in market, scaling what works and moving people through the funnel.

• Turn results into clear recommendations on what to scale, cut and try next.

• Advise senior client stakeholders as a trusted strategic partner, presenting results and recommendations with confidence.

• Identify opportunities to grow accounts, from ongoing optimisation programs to new performance offerings.

• Incorporate an AI-native mindset across the whole strategic process.

• Partner with our product team to invent and build new performance creative solutions, workflows and offerings that scale across clients and studios, going beyond applying existing tools.

• Share learnings and help shape how performance and creative strategy work together.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• 7+ years in performance or growth strategy at an agency or brand, with a focus on performance creative.

• Experience independently leading complex performance strategy engagements and influencing senior client stakeholders and creative leaders.

• A track record of designing and running creative testing programs that improved results.

• Strong analytical skills across major ad platforms, with a working grasp of attribution and measurement.

• Full-funnel experience across paid social, acquisition and conversion.

• The ability to find creative opportunities in data and write briefs creative teams want to run with.

• A belief that brand and performance work best together.

• Genuine curiosity about emerging technology and experience experimenting with or building new workflows.

• Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience working directly with senior clients.

• Curiosity, collaboration and a commitment to growing your strategic craft.

Compensation

Additional Information

Superside's vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we're building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are.

Remote-first. Customer-led.

Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones.

Global team, local impact.

Join a community of 60+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands.

High performance, low ego.

Work in a fast-paced, high-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration.

Impact meets opportunity.

We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here.

Grow fast. Lead well.

You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry.

EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. EDB empowers enterprises to control risk, manage costs and scale efficiently for a data and AI led world. Serving more than 1,500 customers globally and as the leading contributor to the vibrant and fast-growing PostgreSQL community, EDB supports major government organizations, financial services, media and information technology companies. EDB’s data-driven solutions enable customers to modernize legacy systems and break data silos while leveraging enterprise-grade open source technologies. EDB delivers the confidence of up to 99.999% high availability with mission critical capabilities built in such as security, compliance controls, and observability. For more information, visit www.enterprisedb.com

**Candidate Note: This position is 100% remote for candidates based in US**

We're looking for a Staff Engineer that will focus on a Database Platform that supports Postgres estates and fleets. This position owns the packaging and delivery of a number of Kubernetes operators, across the supported cloud Kubernetes environments (EKS, AKS, GKE, OpenShift/RHOS, kind). The work spans Kubernetes packaging, container builds and CI/CD, Postgres-on-Kubernetes infrastructure, and the customer documentation for those capabilities, and it contributes to database release readiness for each release cycle. You will be part of a supportive team with a breadth of experience.

What you will be doing:

• Solving problems for customers by developing easy-to-use systems and features for EDB’s database platform offering(s).

• Leveraging cloud environments to scale our development, testing, and build systems

• Improving the performance and usability of existing products, features, and automated systems

• Collaborating and mentor engineers on a global distributed team to ensure we are using standard methodologies to build scalable, secure, and operationally sound tools and systems.

• Documenting and evangelizing products, features for use by engineers for the development, testing, and packaging of their products

• Implementing and maintaining Kubernetes operators

• Must be able to independently take a feature from design to implementation, delivering according to release dates and deadlines. Working across different development teams in order to ensure cross dependency.

• Developing distributed systems for Kubernetes environments

• Technical writing for customer-facing product documentation that is passed to the documentation team, and documentation for internal stakeholders.

• Ability to present technical explanations to engineering audiences and internal stakeholders in English.

What you will bring:

• Hands-on experience authoring Kubernetes Operators.

• Expert in Golang (Go).

• Deep Kubernetes experience, both managed (e.g. Cloud) and self-managed (e.g. OpenShift, Rancher)

• Container build tooling: Docker, multi-stage and CI image builds.

• Traditional enterprise networking patterns and best practices.

• Ability to manage work in a globally distributed remote environment.

What will set you apart:

• Familiar with OpenShift, familiar for design systems for OpenShift / RHOS packaging and Red Hat certification.

• Appliance or cloud-marketplace delivery, including air-gapped and private-registry install scenarios.

• IAM, Object Storage, Cloud Storage

• Observability for Postgres workloads.

• CI/CD with GitHub Actions; infrastructure-as-code and config management; linting (hadolint, pre-commit).

• Using CloudNativePG or comparable Postgres operators, with solid Postgres operational knowledge.

• High-availability and distributed systems.

Behind our product is a global team of 180+ Beyonders who bring curiosity, craft, and care to everything we do. We believe people are the most important part of any business, starting with ours.

It is with that in mind that Beyond is looking for a Client Revenue Manager to join our growing team. Reporting to our Senior Manager of Professional Services, you will have the opportunity to manage our customers who need an outsourced revenue manager as part of our Guidance offering. As a Client Revenue Manager, you will play a pivotal role in delivering white glove customer experience. The role will also provide cross-functional business exposure to the Revenue Management team. You will work to ensure that these customers are successful and long lasting customers of Beyond to allow us to maintain our foothold as the market leader in this industry. As the world and travel landscape shift around us, so too do the needs of our customers, and this role plays a key component in ensuring that they not only survive but thrive in this environment.

Before reading further…

Beyond is passionate about diversity and cultivating our team’s potential. If you’re hungry for a good opportunity, but don't meet every point in this job description, please apply anyway!

As our Client Revenue Manager, you’ll be responsible for:

• Ensuring our customer’s success by analyzing how they can maximize revenue.

• Serve as their revenue manager and utilize Beyond to review booking data and charts to make pricing decisions

• Providing ad-hoc analyses on booking trends and pricing performance for clients

• Building relationships with customers by driving value using a consultative approach to become an influencer and trusted extension of their team

• Managing approximately 20-30 accounts and drive value to retain clients

• Negotiating annual subscription renewals and upsell opportunities

• Reviewing Beyond’s algorithm performance in existing markets, making actionable recommendations based on data driven insights

• Partnering closely with the Revenue Management, Sales, Product and Customer Experience Teams

• Utilizing strong interpersonal skills to listen while communicating clearly and effectively with clients so they understand the why behind our rates and best practices

• Providing proactive support and service

So what kind of person are we looking for in this role? The person who will be successful in this role will:

• Have deep customer-empathy: you find fulfillment in helping customers reach their goals.

• Enjoy working with people: you are driven to provide an excellent customer experience.

• Be data-minded: you are exceptional with data and leveraging it to make strategic decisions.

• Go above and beyond: you pride yourself on going above and beyond for teammates and customers.

• Be Highly Analytical: you are able to look at multiple graphs and charts and instantly derive insight

Now that we’ve told you what the job looks like, here are the qualifications we're looking for in a candidate:

• At least 2 years of experience working in a client-facing role (customer success, account management, sales, etc.)

• At least 2 years of Revenue Management Experience in a Hospitality or an equivalent industry

• Experience working with software or ability to learn a wide variety of tools for data analysis, including comfort with data sets in excel.

• Succinctly explain the “why” behind data-driven decisions

• Experience helping customers through presentations, trainings, or day-today questions

So what can you expect after you apply? Your application will be personally reviewed by a member of the Beyond hiring team and if you seem like a good addition to our team, you will:

• Have a video conversation with someone on our Recruiting team. This is a high-level conversation about your experience and interest, but also an opportunity for you to learn more about us

• Meet with our Manager of Professional Services for a deeper dive video conversation

• Complete an assignment relevant to the role and meet with a few additional members of the Customer Experience team

• Meet with our Vice President of Customer Experience or General Manager

Company Values:

We are serious about our core values: We Care, We Are On the Same Team, We Inspire Trust, We Go Beyond, We Ship It, We're Curious. If those resonate with you, and you're ready to work with a team that lives and breathes those values, we want to hear from you.

Flex is building AI-native financial services for business owners .

We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.

Since launching publicly in September 2023 , Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue , with a clear path to profitability by late 2026 . We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue) —the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

- Mission-critical problems : We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.

- High bar, low ego : Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.

- Speed over comfort : We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.

- Enduring impact : What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.

Team & Locations

We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

About the Role

We're seeking an ambitious problem solver with a record of achievement on an exponential trajectory.

As City Manager, you'll lead Flex's growth in New York. You know the business owners, the culture, and which rooms matter. Your job is to turn that into new Flex customers.

You'll build a target list of 50 business owners you'd most like to bring to Flex. From that list, you'll identify five North Star accounts; the high-priority relationships that could have a meaningful impact on Flex's growth and visibility in your market.

Your job is to develop a strategy for reaching those owners, building relationships, and ultimately bringing their businesses onto Flex. Some opportunities will move quickly, while others will take time. You'll also build relationships within their networks, creating additional opportunities for customer acquisition.

You'll take ownership of these relationships from the first conversation through conversion, working with our sales and industry teams to move opportunities forward.

You'll work closely with teams across Flex, including sales, finance, marketing, operations, and leadership, plus City Managers in other markets. Your city is yours to run, with a team behind you.

What You'll Do

• Build and own the city’s dream list of 50 owners, prioritizing five North Star accounts and identifying the best path to each.

• Curate rooms built around the people on your list: Plan and host events that bring the right people together, including intimate dinners, customer gatherings, and strategic brand activations.

• Develop relationships with prospective customers and guide them from initial conversations through account opening, staying involved as their businesses grow with Flex.

• Evaluate and negotiate sponsorships and memberships, and only say yes to the ones that put you in front of people on the list.

• Develop a monthly market plan covering your priority accounts, upcoming initiatives, and progress toward customer acquisition.

• Collaborate with internal teams to move opportunities forward, generate customer referrals, and share insights from your market.

• Maintain an organized pipeline, track applications and referrals, coordinate events, and manage your local budget.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days: Your 50 are written, your five are picked, your first rooms have happened and you’re in real conversations with your North Star accounts.

First year: Your North Star accounts are on Flex, the customers you brought in are active and spending, and people around the city are sending you introductions without being asked.

Above all, we care about results: accounts closed and how they use Flex once they’re open. Plenty of great customers will come from outside your list, and those count too.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. About MetaMask

MetaMask is building a future where users can unlock the full product stack through a single, seamless identity experience, enabling access to all features with trust, safety, and minimal friction.

Today, identity verification is fragmented across several product and onboarding experiences. Users are repeatedly asked to verify themselves across different services, creating unnecessary friction, inconsistent outcomes, and degraded trust.

Universal KYC (UKYC) is a new initiative to solve this problem by creating a single, reusable identity layer across MetaMask. At the centre of this is MetaMask Passport , a product designed to enable users to verify once and unlock multiple experiences across the MetaMask ecosystem.

This role sits at the intersection of platform and product experience . You will define the primitives, standards, and user journeys that make identity verification seamless, privacy-conscious, and globally compliant.

What you’ll do

You will own the vision and roadmap for Universal KYC and MetaMask Passport, defining how a reusable identity layer unlocks the broader MetaMask product stack. You will build the underlying identity platform, creating scalable verification primitives and standards that can be adopted across products. In parallel, you will design a seamless, low-friction KYC experience that reduces time-to-first-transaction while maintaining compliance integrity. You will drive adoption across MetaMask by partnering closely with internal teams to integrate a consistent identity layer, while balancing privacy, trust, and global regulatory requirements. Throughout, you will lead execution end-to-end, aligning cross-functional teams and delivering measurable outcomes.

What we are looking for:

• Proven experience building or scaling identity verification (IDV), KYC, or onboarding products

• Strong background in fintech , ideally with exposure to Web3

• Hands-on experience working with identity verification providers (IDV vendors) such as Sumsub, Veriff, Onfido, Persona, or Stripe Identity

• Familiarity with compliance workflows , including KYC, KYB, and customer due diligence (CDD) processes

• Track record of delivering platform products adopted across multiple teams

• Ability to operate across both technical systems and user experience

What Success looks like:

• Increased KYC completion rates and reduced onboarding friction

• Reduced time-to-first-transaction across KYC-gated flows

• Increased reuse of verified identity across products

• Improved transaction success rate through consistent verification outcomes

• Strong user trust with minimal friction and compliant execution

Attributes that will make you stand out

• First-principles thinker with strong product judgment

• Deep user empathy with a focus on reducing friction and cognitive load

• Strong understanding of trust, privacy, and compliance trade-offs

• Clear, structured communicator who drives alignment and momentum

• High ownership and ability to operate in ambiguity

Why This Role Matters

Universal KYC is a foundational unlock for MetaMask, enabling users to move from fragmented, repetitive identity verification to a seamless, reusable experience across the entire product stack. It establishes a scalable, privacy-conscious identity layer that strengthens user trust while meeting global compliance requirements. This is a high-leverage role at the intersection of access, trust, and growth, critical to unlocking the next phase of MetaMask’s evolution.

Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

FDNA is a pioneer in AI-powered phenotyping and precision health, dedicated to expediting the diagnosis and care management of rare genetic and developmental disorders. Used across more than 10,000 medical centers in over 130 countries, our ecosystem and products bridges the gap between concerned parents, healthcare providers, and life sciences organization.

About the Role
We are seeking a strategic, execution-driven Head of Product based in Latin America to own the end-to-end product vision, roadmap, and delivery across FDNA’s clinical, patient-facing, and interoperability product lines. Reporting directly to the executive leadership team (working closely with our Chief Product & Technology Officer, Chief Medical Officer, and AI Research leads), you will translate cutting-edge multimodal AI capabilities into intuitive, compliant, and clinically impactful products tailored primarily for the US healthcare ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

• Product Strategy & Lifecycle Ownership: Define and execute the multi-product roadmap across Face2Gene, Family Health Checker, and FDNA’s Provider/Pharma Data Clearinghouse, balancing clinician utility, patient engagement, and B2B/life sciences monetization.

• US Clinical Workflow & EHR Integration: Architect seamless product experiences that fit naturally into US pediatric, genetic, and primary care clinical workflows, driving HL7/FHIR-based EHR integrations, digital intake, and specialist referral pathways.

• Regulatory & Compliance Governance: Partner with Legal, Clinical, and Security teams to ensure all product features strictly adhere to HIPAA privacy/security mandates, de-identification protocols, and FDA Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) / Clinical Decision Support (CDS) regulatory boundaries.

• AI-to-Product Translation: Collaborate closely with AI/ML engineering and medical genetics teams to productize novel multimodal models (facial analysis, video, audio, and clinical notes) while maintaining high standards for clinical transparency, bias mitigation, and explainability.

• Cross-Functional & Nearshore Leadership: Lead, mentor, and scale a distributed product management and UX/UI design function across time zones, fostering tight alignment between LATAM-based teams, US-based commercial/clinical stakeholders, and global R&D centers.

• Customer & Market Discovery: Conduct continuous discovery with US health systems, pediatric specialists, genetic counselors, patient advocacy groups, and pharma/CRO partners to validate product-market fit and measure clinical and commercial outcomes.

- Experience: 6+ years of progressive product management experience, including at least 2+ years in a senior leadership role (Director or Head of Product) owning multiple interconnected software products.
- Dedicated US Healthcare Exposure (Mandatory): ≥50% of your career (3+ years minimum) must be directly dedicated to building and scaling products for the US healthcare market, demonstrating hands-on mastery of:

• HIPAA Compliance & Data Privacy: Managing PHI/PII, BAAs, SOC 2 standards, and de-identified real-world data (RWD) exchange.

• FDA & SaMD Parameters: Navigating FDA guidance on Clinical Decision Support (CDS) software, SaMD classifications, and non-diagnostic informational labeling.

• US EHR Integrations: Hands-on experience shipping integrations with major US EHRs (e.g., Epic, Oracle Cerner, athenahealth) utilizing HL7, FHIR, SMART on FHIR, or clearinghouse APIs.

• US Clinical Workflows: Deep familiarity with US provider intake, referral management, care coordination, and specialty clinical environments.

- Location & Alignment: Residing in any Latin American country with strong overlap with US Eastern/Central business hours and fluent, executive-level English communication skills.
- AI / Data-Intensive Product Track Record: Proven experience bringing data-heavy, algorithmic, or AI/ML-powered healthcare applications from concept to commercial adoption.

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience with rare diseases, clinical genomics, pediatrics, digital diagnostics, or life sciences/CRO real-world data platforms.

• Background working in high-growth healthtech startups or distributed international R&D organizations.

• Familiarity with consumer-to-provider ("digital front door") patient acquisition and engagement funnels.

CV/Resume submissions MUST be in English.

About Us and Why We're Hiring

We're ChiroCat, and we build cloud-based chiropractic software that practices across the United States love and trust. From the first patient interactions with digital intake forms to the final insurance processing and post-visit communication, our system supports doctors and their staff every step of the way. We’re modernizing the chiropractic software space in big ways, but much more importantly, we’re bettering the lives of our doctors, their team members, and especially their patients.

The bottom line: we LOVE to help people who help people. And that’s where you come in!

We’re building something special at ChiroCat; both with our product and the people behind it. We’re not like “the other guys,” and our customers know it. They tell us, and more and more, they’re telling their peers about ChiroCat, too. But truth be told, we haven’t done a great job of showcasing what sets us apart to the rest of the world. And now we want everyone to feel that from the first time they come across us.

That’s where you come in! We’re hiring our first dedicated marketer. If you’re the right fit, you know that a brand is much more than a logo, voice is more than just words, and a website isn’t just a funnel. You’re a skilled writer and will help us find our voice and strengthen it. You’ve been around the block and know how to build a strategy toward a better future, but you’re not satisfied to sit behind reports and dashboards. You’re excited to roll up your sleeves and start doing the work yourself. Website, ads, social, email, internal guidelines, in-app messaging: you’ll touch all of it. And as we grow, your opportunity grows with us.

What We're Looking For

REQUIREMENTS

For this role, you must:

•
Have at least 4 years of hands-on marketing experience, including real ownership of brand, messaging, and content (not just executing someone else’s plan)

•
Be an exceptional writer who can adapt to a brand’s voice, and have samples to show us

•
Have hands-on experience running paid social campaigns: building them, testing creative, and improving results based on what the numbers tell you

•
Have experience managing a company’s social media presence, including engaging with the community, and not just publishing posts

•
Be comfortable writing and updating website and landing page content in a CMS (Currently Webflow)

•
Be self-directed: you can take an ambiguous list of needs, decide what matters most, and make a case for it; continuously iterating your way toward excellence

•
Be a thoughtful communicator in written and spoken forms. It’s an art you enjoy improving!

•
Love to learn. In short order, you’ll need to get fluent in the world of chiropractic, medical practices, and the people who run them.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

These aren't required, but will help you stand out:

•
Marketing experience in healthcare, medical practice, or B2B SaaS

•
Experience shaping or refreshing a brand’s voice, messaging, or identity

•
Experience leading a small team, or managing freelancers and agencies

•
Design skills (Figma, Canva, or similar). If you use AI design tools, you use them with enough taste that nobody can tell.

•
Experience with email marketing platforms and in-app messaging tools (we use Intercom)

•
Experience managing online reviews and reputation (G2, Capterra, Google)

•
Comfort making short-form video

•
Familiarity with chiropractic care. (Being a happy chiropractic patient counts a little.)

Note: If you believe you’re a fit, but don’t meet our preferred qualifications, still apply! We’re more interested in finding the right person, than the perfect resume.

Life at ChiroCat

ChiroCat started with a simple mission: Empowering caregivers to transform lives through tools they trust. In an industry dominated by big conglomerates or funding-dependent startups, we're privately owned and stable. That means we can run our business as we choose. Our culture is built on genuine care for our customers, each other, and the meaningful work we do.

HOW YOU'LL WORK AT CHIROCAT

Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We’re based in southern Utah, but most of our team works remotely. This role is open to candidates located in U.S. time zones (Pacific, Mountain, Central, Eastern) or internationally within UTC-8 to UTC-4. You’ll need to live in one of these time zones, since this role requires strong overlap with our team and customers. Working these hours from elsewhere won’t qualify.

Balanced Work, Balanced Life: We work a standard 40-hour week and are fans of legitimately unplugging after hours. We're in this for the long haul and want you rested and focused. Exceptions exist, but we mostly work standard business hours in our local time zone.

Take Vacation (Seriously): Most team members take three to four weeks per year — real vacations where you're not tied to your laptop or phone. We'll look forward to seeing pictures in our team #water-cooler

jobs.description:

URL: https://sweetspothvac.com/

About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling
SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here owns the function, works directly with the owner, and has a real path to leading the team as we scale.
About the role
We are hiring a creative strategist who will own paid ad creative end to end: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefing creators and editors, and the learnings that turn winners into the next batch.
This is not a "make pretty ads" role and it is not strategy-only. You will direct really strong video editors and UGC creators, and you will use AI (including Claude Code) as your production engine for research, hooks, scripts and variants. We are honest about the level this role is hired at: we are looking for strong raw talent with real direct-response instincts who wants ownership and serious training, and who wants to grow into a top-tier strategist with us. You will get mentorship, a proven creative system, and weekly learnings reviews. In return we expect pace, curiosity, and work you can defend.
What you will do

• Build the research base first: homeowner avatars, desires, objections, competitors, and our own ad account history. No angles before research.

• Plan concepts in a structured roadmap, each with angle, avatar, desire, mechanism, authority, awareness level, emotion, positioning and urgency.

• Write hooks and scripts built for the first 3 seconds: one desire, one avatar, one message per ad.

• Brief UGC creators and editors so clearly they can execute with no follow-up call, and review their work to a finished, launch-ready ad.

• Run the testing system: from one winning angle, build structured iterations where each variation tests something named.

• Run the learnings: label every ad (Breakthrough, Spend Winner, KPI Winner, Loser), state why it performed, and turn that into the next round.

• Hit 20 to 30 finished, launch-ready ads per month at full pace, working with our editors and AI workflows.

What we are looking for

• Direct-response ad experience: you have written ads that ran as paid social (Meta or TikTok) and you can show them.

• A testing system, not just good taste. You can explain how you turn one winner into 20 variations.

• Research discipline. Your hooks trace to evidence, not guesses.

• AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your creative workflow and can show how.

• Execution: you have briefed creators or managed editors and shipped finished ads.

• Ownership mindset: you talk about business outcomes, not just outputs delivered, and you close feedback loops: you learn, you apply, you show what changed.

• Local services or lead generation experience is a plus, not a requirement. Seasonal urgency, emergency calls, proof and trust are the game here.

Pay and structure

• Contract (1099), remote, month-to-month: $4,000 to $8,000 per month, 40 hours per week, based on experience.

• Performance bonus structure discussed after the trial month, tied to winning ads.

• Growth path: this seat grows into leading the creative team. One of the paths we model is editor or strategist to team lead as spend scales.

Our hiring process (exactly how it works)

• Short application: portfolio of ads you wrote that actually ran, plus 3 short answers (your testing system on a real winner; one ad you iterated and what it tested; your AI workflow).

• Interview 1 (30 minutes): screening and craft in one call, run as a working session on your past ads: what did you learn, how did you apply it, what feedback loops did you complete.

• Paid test: $100 flat, 48 hours, capped at 4 hours of work, paid regardless of outcome. A short research snapshot, hooks, scripts, an iteration plan and an execution plan for a real scenario.

• Interview 2 (final, with the owner): we walk your test together and you defend your choices. References are checked after this call (we will ask to speak with one past employer). Two interviews total, no more.

• Paid 30-day trial at your full agreed monthly rate, with daily contact, mentorship and a weekly check-in. Written decision at day 30.

We hire off the test and the trial, not the interview. If you are the kind of strategist who would rather prove it than pitch it, apply.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweetspot-heating-and-cooling-creative-strategist-ai-native-direct-response

About Pacaso

Pacaso exists to enrich lives by making second home ownership possible and enjoyable for more people. We've reimagined the second home category — pairing a thoughtfully designed co-ownership model with simplified financials, equitable scheduling, and dedicated local property management, so owners get the joy of a true second home without the hassle.

Since launch, Pacaso has facilitated more than $1.2 billion in gross real estate transactions and service fees across 40+ destinations in the U.S., Mexico, and Europe — including Aspen, Lake Tahoe, Napa, Malibu, Palm Springs, Cabo, Paris, London, and most recently Florence, Milan, and Rome. We've raised over $300 million in cumulative equity funding , closed the largest real estate Regulation A+ offering of 2025, and reserved the Nasdaq ticker PCSO as we build toward a public listing.

Our work has been featured in The New York Times , The Wall Street Journal , Fortune , Forbes , CNBC , Bloomberg , and others.

Recognition

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for both our culture and our category-defining work:

• No. 5, Forbes America's Best Startup Employers (2026) — our second consecutive Top 10 ranking

• Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2025)

• Winner, 2025 Inman Best of Proptech Awards — Consumer Experience & Marketplace Innovation

• Fortune & Great Place To Work Best Workplaces in Real Estate (2024)

• Best Workplace in the Bay Area™ (2023)

• LinkedIn Top Startup (2022) · Glassdoor Best Places to Work, #6 (2022)

The role

Pacaso buyers are high-net-worth individuals making a considered purchase over months, sometimes years. They move between our site, email, messaging, and our Sales team, and today each of those runs on its own tools with its own picture of the customer. We believe one personalized system that follows each customer from first interest to purchase, and keeps serving them as an owner, will shorten the path to purchase and make our growth product-led.

We're hiring a principal-level technical product IC to architect that system and own its outcome. You'll define the reference architecture: how we recognize a customer across channels, what we know about them, how the system decides what to do next, and which of those decisions AI agents can make without a person. You'll prove the design with working prototypes you build yourself with AI tooling, then lead Engineering and Data in taking it to production.

This isn't a roadmap-and-backlog PM role, and it isn't a full-time production engineering role. It sits between them. You'll make product calls with Sales, Marketing, and leadership, make architecture calls with senior engineers, and be accountable for both.

Some of this is already moving. AI agents talk to our customers today, and parts of the data and decisioning exist. None of it runs end to end on its own yet. You'll take what's there, decide what to keep, and design the system that can.

What you'll own

• The architecture of the customer system. One design for new leads, dormant leads, and stalled buyers first, then owners who add a share, so the same person is served by one system instead of separate tools for each stage. You write the architecture and the decisions behind it, and other teams build against it.

• The customer intelligence layer. Identity across channels, the event and signal model, shared memory and context, scoring, eligibility and frequency caps, and the next-best-action logic that decides what happens next.

About PropertyTek
PropertyTek is a private equity-backed holding company transforming property management through a growing portfolio of SaaS brands. Our products power leasing automation for single- and multifamily residential property managers.

We're looking for a Marketing Automation Specialist who thrives in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment. This is a role that will build the systems that move leads through our marketing funnel, directly supporting Sales and our mission to transform the property technology landscape.

Role Overview
We're hiring a Marketing Automation Specialist to own HubSpot workflow architecture across our property management SaaS portfolio (ShowMojo and Tenant Turner). This is not an execution-only role: the person in this seat designs and builds the automation logic that drives lifecycle marketing, not just runs pre-built workflows.

This is a contractor position, remote, Philippines-based preferred.

Key Responsibilities
Workflow Architecture

• Design and build multi-branch HubSpot workflows from scratch, not just editing existing sequences

• Architect lead scoring models tailored to property management buyer behavior

• Build segmentation logic specific to the property management vertical (portfolio size, unit count, market, product line — ShowMojo vs. Tenant Turner)

• Design lifecycle-stage email flows: lead nurture, trial/onboarding, activation, upsell/expansion, renewal, win-back

Hubspot Execution

• Set up campaigns in HubSpot, bringing together the emails, landing pages, forms, and assets for each one

• Build and send emails in HubSpot, including newsletters, one-off sends, and nurture emails

• QA every email before it goes out

• Own the marketing email calendar: keep it current, keep every team informed of what's going out and when, and make sure sends stick to the schedule

• Coordinate email sends with Customer Success

• Keep HubSpot organized with consistent naming and foldering for emails, lists, and campaigns

• Own UTM tracking on every email and campaign link, so each click gets credited to the right campaign

Content & Landing Pages

• Write email copy for automated email workflows sequences

• Build and publish landing pages in HubSpot's CMS/page tools to support campaigns and lifecycle flows

• Publish blog posts and pages in WordPress

• Ensure workflows, content, and landing pages work as one connected system

Ongoing Optimization

• Run and maintain our lead nurture flows: keep emails, offers, and links current, and test changes that improve engagement and conversions

• Monitor email performance and revise logic accordingly; share the results and make regular optimization recommendations to the team

• Maintain clean data hygiene practices within workflows (list membership, enrollment/re-enrollment logic, suppression rules)

Required Qualifications

• Demonstrated HubSpot workflow architecture experience — must be able to design multi-branch automation from a blank canvas, not just configure templates

• Hands-on experience building lead scoring models

• Experience building segmentation strategies (behavioral, firmographic, or lifecycle-based)

• Experience designing lifecycle-stage email flows (nurture through renewal)

• Experience building landing pages in HubSpot's CMS or page builder tools

• Hands-on HubSpot Marketing Hub experience: building emails, landing pages, and campaigns

• 3+ years in marketing automation, ideally with at least 1–2 years focused specifically on HubSpot

• Strong B2B email copywriting skills, with samples you can share

• Experience publishing content in WordPress

• A sharp eye for QA: you catch broken links, wrong personalization tokens, and rendering issues before anything goes out

• Comfortable reading email performance data (opens, clicks, conversions) and turning it into clear recommendations

• Organized and proactive, with the communication skills to keep multiple teams aligned on a shared calendar

• Comfortable working independently in a remote, asynchronous, US-hours-adjacent environment

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience in property management, real estate, or a related vertical (rental software, PropTech, or landlord/tenant-facing products)

• HubSpot certification(s) — Marketing Software, Email Marketing, or Reporting

• Experience working across multiple product lines or brands within one HubSpot portal

• Experience with A/B testing email sequences and using results to refine workflow logic

• Experience running or maintaining lead nurture and lifecycle email flows

• Experience with UTM tracking and campaign attribution

Schedule and Availability
This role is a full-time equivalent of about 160 hours a month. Your working day should overlap consistently with US Eastern morning hours, when our standups, Sales syncs, and most async requests happen.

Company Description

WiseTech Global is a leading developer and provider of innovative software solutions for the logistics, global trade and supply chain industries worldwide. We serve more than 22,000 logistics companies across 193 countries, 23 of the 25 largest global freight forwarders worldwide. With the acquisition of e2open, we have expanded our network to encompass over 500,000 connected enterprises across manufacturing, logistics, channels and distribution. With the vision to be the operating system for global trade and logistics, we are creating a multi-sided marketplace connecting carriers, logistics providers, importers, exporters and shippers.

Job Description

A Pivotal Moment — Why Join E2open Now
In August 2025 WiseTech Global, developer of the world's leading logistics execution software CargoWise, completed its strategic acquisition of e2open. This acquisition represents one of the most significant strategic moves in global supply chain technology in recent years, and it creates an extraordinary moment to join this business.
WiseTech's CargoWise platform has historically focused on logistics service providers such as freight forwarders, carriers, and customs brokers. The e2open acquisition brings a deep, complementary product suite and customer base on the other side of the supply chain: the buyers, importers, exporters, shippers, manufacturers and brand owners who generate the freight in the first place.
Together, the two businesses create something that has never existed before: a truly end-to-end, multi-sided global trade and logistics marketplace connecting demand, planning, supply, channel, transportation and execution in one ecosystem, all underpinned by AI and data at scale.
The Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced and driven Area Sales Director to join our growing US sales organization. Each Area Sales Director owns a portfolio of approximately 20-30 enterprise accounts within our CPG business unit.
This role sits at the intersection of sales and professional services, with our most successful team members acting as strategic consultants and trusted advisors to our clients to help drive wider adoption of our existing product suite. This role covers the full spectrum of client engagement, from identifying opportunities and closing deals to staying involved throughout implementation to ensure successful delivery.
What You'll Do

• Build and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving cross-sell, upsell and new logo revenue.

• Develop trusted, senior-level relationships across your accounts through engaging stakeholders beyond the primary sponsor and maintaining a regular meeting cadence.

• Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients understand the full value of e2open's platform and keeping satisfaction high.

• Create and maintain detailed account plans and close plans at the opportunity level.

• Partner with Solutions Consulting, Legal, Professional Services and other internal teams to progress and close deals.

• Accurately maintain Salesforce CRM and report on pipeline, activities and performance metrics.

• Represent e2open at industry events to stay current on market trends and generate new business opportunities.

Salary: $100,000-$150,000 Base + Uncapped Commission

Qualifications

What You'll Bring

• 8–10+ years in supply chain and logistics, whether in consulting, operations, solution architecture, or enterprise B2B SaaS sales (exposure to S&OP, demand planning or inventory optimization in a CPG environment is highly preferred).

• Experience selling supply chain, logistics, ERP or adjacent enterprise software.

• Proven ability to close and manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals across long sales cycles.

• Confident presenting to C-suite and VP-level executives, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Consultative, value-based selling approach with genuine curiosity about customer challenges.

• Ability to articulate technical solutions clearly in business terms.

• Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and opportunities concurrently.

• Proficiency in Salesforce or equivalent CRM; strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

Additional Information

When you join WiseTech, you’re joining a team of passionate problem solvers who are committed to changing the world of logistics, one innovation at a time. At the heart of WiseTech’s success lies our exceptional team of people, whose diverse talents and unwavering dedication drive the company forward. Our team’s broad mix of experiences and backgrounds is not merely a feature but a cornerstone of our vibrant and dynamic culture.

• Ensure AI-assisted changes keep the same review, approval, and audit trail as any other change.

Build monitoring, alerting, and runbooks

• Keep runbooks current and written so that both people and AI assistants can follow them.

Keep systems patched and current

Lead OS upgrades, runtime and end-of-life migrations, dependency updates, and certificate renewals.

About Elavate
Elavate is a multi-collagen supplement brand for women 40+, built around the changes that come with perimenopause and menopause. Our founder, Alex Philip, started it after getting fed up buying overpriced, low-quality, bad-tasting collagen for his mum.
Since launching in 2024 we've become one of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the UK, with over 35,000 five-star reviews. We launched in the US in 2026, and it's now our biggest focus for growth.
Our growth runs on video ads: UGC, influencer and celebrity talent content, made with an in-house team of creative strategists and video editors. The better the creators and the content, the faster we grow. That's where you come in.

The role

Our creative strategists write the scripts and our editors turn footage into ads. You're the person in the middle who makes the content happen: finding the right creators, briefing and storyboarding every script, running influencer and high-production shoots with our agency partners, and making sure every video that comes back is right.
You'll handle two kinds of content:

• UGC: creators film themselves at home from our briefs, so the brief has to do all the directing

• Influencer and high-production shoots: the two go hand in hand. We film well-known influencers and TV personalities with a professional crew, at a location picked for the look, with lighting, a teleprompter and make-up. These shoots make our long-form direct response ads, plus the hooks, product shots and B-roll that go with them

You'll work across both markets, the UK and the US, alongside our founder and creative team.
This is a communications, creators and systems role. You want to be in it every day: talking to creators, getting content made and getting deals done. Strategy experience is a plus, not a requirement.

What you'll own

Find and sign the best creators in the UK and US

• Source new UGC creators every week, mostly women 40+ who come across as natural, expressive and believable on camera

• Vet properly before anyone gets a brief: watch their content, judge their delivery, setting and camera skills, and only put forward people you'd bet on

• Get in touch fast and keep every conversation moving. The best creators get booked up quickly, so speed wins the deal

• Negotiate good deals: strong rates, the right usage and whitelisting terms, and every deliverable written in (videos, hooks, raw files, B-roll)

• Keep the pipeline full so our strategists never wait on talent

Build and run our creator database

• Build a database of the best UGC creators in the UK and US, and keep it up to date every week

• Log every creator after every job: contact details, rates, niche, past jobs, how their content performed, delivery quality and whether we'd rebook them

• Keep a bench of proven creators we can rebook at short notice

• Keep an eye on creative performance in Motion, so you know which creators and videos are winning and can find, rebook and brief more like them

• Run product sendouts: get product out as soon as a deal is signed and confirm it's arrived

Brief and storyboard every script

• Turn finished scripts from our strategists into briefs a creator can film without guessing: a scene-by-scene storyboard, B-roll, visual direction, setting, outfits and props

• Lock every brief before it goes out: one final version, a clear deadline, a reference video and links you've tested

• Run a quick test clip before each full batch, so problems get caught before they cost us a refilm

Coordinate our influencer and high-production shoots

• Work hand in hand with our content agency and shoot production agency: they run the day-to-day logistics on our crewed shoots, you make sure nothing gets missed

• Run the threads with agents and talent managers on scheduling, call times and riders

• Own the details: locations, props, product on set and a checklist to the crew before every shoot

Check content and get it live

• Check every delivery against the script within 24 hours of filming: every hook, every section, resolution, lighting, framing and product shots

• Post a written verdict for the team on what's good and exactly what's wrong (a thumbs-up isn't a check), so refilm calls get made fast

• Once content is approved, get sign-off from the talent side, secure whitelisting access and hand clean files to our editors

How we work (read this part properly)

This is what makes or breaks the role, so we're being specific.

Grow our AI image service. Before you apply, spend ten minutes on our website and LinkedIn. In your Loom we will ask what we do, where you found out about us, and why you want to work at Drop Zero Digital. Answers that could be about any company will not pass.
The role We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.
You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

• The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.

• Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.
Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.
This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.
We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.
What we are looking for
• You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.

• You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.

• You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.

• You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.

• You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.

• You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.
On experience We do not ask for a number of years. We check your work history against what you tell us, and a false answer ends the application.
Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.
How the process works, and we tell you all of it now
• Application with a short Loom video. Research us first.

• A short test by email: one real decision task, your internet speed, your computer, and a paragraph on your work history.

• A 15 minute call with the founder.

• A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.

• Aptitude tests. These inform us, they do not decide.

• A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.
The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

• Full time once hired, and this is your only job. During the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 of them at a fixed time inside our working day, and you can keep your current job. If you pass, you give notice and join us full time within 30 days.

• Reliable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.

• Strong written English.

• Based in Argentina.

• You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

2100 USD per month from day one, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.
On top of that:

• A one-month annual bonus.

• 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.

• Paid sick leave.

• A health allowance.

• A coworking allowance.
Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.

We are hiring an engineer to own the document processing pipelines end to end: design, benchmarking, experimenting with new architectures and tools, threshold required for deploying a new pipeline, etc.

We believe it's important to build our own tooling to help us run, improve, and measure our applications. Therefore, the ideal candidate thinks outside the box on how to not just build the product/pipeline, but also the tooling needed around it.

You will be the first dedicated ML hire on the product taking over from the engineering manager who build the current solution and will work directly with the founding engineering team.

This is a senior, hands-on individual-contributor role, but we are small team and you'll be involved in design, planning, roadmapping, and architectural decisions.

What you will do

Design the pipelines. Own the architecture of the extraction-to-posting pipelines: page classification, field extraction, candidate retrieval, claim matching, confidence gating and the hand-off to human review, etc. Decide where rules end and models begin, and what each stage must guarantee to the next, what the separation of concerns are, etc.

We have different pipelines for different document types and expect that at any given point in time we may have new ones emerge and may consolidate others.

Evaluate new systems before we adopt them. Run structured trials of candidate components and recommend what to keep. Examples include probabilistic record linkage (Splink), Azure AI Content Understanding and Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI and Foundry-hosted models, and LLM agents with tools. Similarly, test new models with the existing pipeline as they are relased from the frontier labs.

Build the evaluation process. You'll own the process of evaluating false positives, false negatives, errors of ommission, etc, that we ultimately use to determine if we should upgrade the pipeline.

Ship and operate. Take components from trial to production in our python workers on the cloud, instrument them, watch cost and quota, and diagnose the cases reviewers send back.

Set direction. Work with leadereship on the planing for accuracy, cost improvement, and overall product improvements.

What we are looking for

Required

• 6+ years building ML or data-intensive systems, at least 3 of them owning a production pipeline whose output people acted on.

• Solid backend engineering understanding and ideally cloud architecture understanding.

jobs.sourceName: RSS: We Work Remotely: Sales and Marketing
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

URL: http://convertibles.dev

About us
Convertibles is a CRO and Shopify development agency for 8 and 9 figure D2C brands. We've just brought Google and YouTube ads in-house under the same roof, run by our co-founder Clay. He's been doing Google Ads for ecommerce since 2013: built and exited his own brand on Google Ads and CRO, then ran Google and YouTube for brands spending $50k to $500k+ a month on Google alone. The ads book today is around seven brands across the US, UK, EU and Australia, and it's growing.
The role
This is an apprenticeship with a real job attached. You work directly with Clay (x @ecomclay), learn how he runs accounts, and within 90 days you're running the weekly cycle on your first accounts yourself.
The weekly cycle, concretely:

• Monday: pull last week's numbers (Google Ads platform side plus the client's attribution tool - Triple Whale, Converge or Northbeam), update the reporting workbook, write the client update, produce the actions list. Exact campaign, exact change, why.

• Through the week: make the changes, watch pacing, check feeds and Merchant Center, build new campaigns (Search, Shopping, PMax, YouTube / Demand Gen).

• Client calls: sit in first, then run them.

How we work, so you know what you're signing up for

• YouTube and Demand Gen are the main event, not a side channel. We take a brand's winning Meta ads, recut them for YouTube, and scale. Accounts have gone from YouTube at 6-12% of media mix to 13-22%, at a return that held for over a year.

• Attribution-tool numbers decide YouTube, not platform numbers. If you've only ever judged campaigns on what Google Ads says, you'll learn a different lens.

• Everything gets a number. "Performance improved" is not a finding. "NC-CPA went from £38 to £30 on the same spend" is.

• AI is part of the workflow. Reporting workbooks, data pulls and first drafts are built with Claude. You don't need to be a developer, but you need to be comfortable working this way.

• There's a dev, CRO, QA and design team behind the ads. When a landing page or a feed needs fixing, someone fixes it.

Who fits

• 2-4 years hands-on in Google Ads for ecommerce. Your hands on the account, not managing someone whose hands are.

• You've run Search, Shopping and PMax on real budgets (at least one account at $20k+/month). You've at least touched YouTube or Demand Gen and want to go deep on it.

• Comfortable in Google Sheets / Excel. You can look at eight weeks of campaign data and tell me what changed and why.

• You know what a Merchant Center disapproval is and how to fix it.

• You write clearly in English. You'll be writing to clients by week five.

• Curious, direct, not precious about being told you're wrong.

Not a fit: agency account managers who relay what the specialist did. Meta buyers who "also do Google". Anyone who needs the basics explained.
Hours
Full-time, 40h/wk. Your morning overlaps with Clay (he's UTC+8), your afternoon overlaps with UK/EU clients and the US East Coast. Flexible beyond that.
First 90 days

• Weeks 1-4: shadow. Pull the data, build the workbooks, sit on every call.

• Weeks 5-8: draft the Monday updates and actions lists for two accounts. Clay reviews before they go out.

• Weeks 9-12: own the weekly cycle and the check-in call on your first account.

Comp is reviewed at 90 days. The per-account bonus starts when you own an account.
What you get
Direct training from someone who's done this for 13 years, on his own money and then on clients'. A team behind you. A real path: run accounts, then lead the Google / YouTube lane.
How to apply
Keep it short. Answer the questions in the form with numbers, not adjectives. Shortlisted people do a paid 2-3 hour test task, then a call with Clay.

As a rapidly growing financial technology company, we’re reaching new heights with a bold vision. We’re set to acquire a banking license, unlocking a world of possibilities for our customers. This transition will allow us to expand our lending across more EU countries and broaden our product suite to deliver even more value.

Join us on this journey and let’s build the future of finance together!

What is this role about? 🚀

As a CRM Manager , you build and run the customer journeys that guide Bondora’s customers through their whole lifecycle: from their first loan application and onboarding, to repeat loans and add-ons, to the moments when repayments get difficult. You’ll be one of three CRM Managers in Bondora’s CRM & Customer Value team, reporting to the Head of CRM & Customer Value. Our CRM runs on Braze, with unusually rich customer and loan data and value signals already flowing in. You’ll decide what to build by its value in loans and euros, prove what works against holdout groups, and treat every customer fairly: a loan is a financial decision, not a shopping cart.

Your main responsibilities 🎯

• Build and run customer journeys in Braze across the lifecycle: application and onboarding, repeat loans and add-ons, reactivation, and payment difficulty, with QA before every launch and zero customer-facing errors.

• Design journeys around the customer’s situation: triggers, timing, cadence, channels and fallback, stop rules, and handovers to self-service, a human or another journey.

• Prove what works: build a control or holdout into every journey and report results as business outcomes (signed loans, revenue, arrears), not opens or clicks.

• Prioritise by value: size opportunities in loans and euros before building, and rank your work by value rather than volume.

• Own compliance and risk suppression: classify messages correctly, respect consent, never send commercial messages to customers showing payment risk, and involve Legal and Risk before launch.

• Keep the data reliable: validate events and attributes, fix journeys that act on wrong or late data, and escalate upstream issues with evidence.

• Move legacy communications into Braze and work through the team’s shared rules: one intake route for requests, and clean handovers with the other CRM Managers.

What would ensure success in this role?💪

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in CRM or lifecycle marketing. Experience in lending, fintech or recurring-revenue businesses is a plus.

• Hands-on production experience in Braze or a comparable platform (Iterable, Customer.io, Salesforce Marketing Cloud): journeys, segmentation, event and API triggers, dynamic content and QA. You build it yourself, not through an agency.

• Experience designing journeys for different lifecycle stages, built around the customer’s situation rather than a fixed sequence.

• Experimentation literacy: you design tests with holdouts, read business outcomes rather than open rates, and can pull your own data (SQL or a product analytics tool).

• Commercial judgment: you can estimate what an improvement is worth in loans and euros and decide what to build first.

• Sound compliance judgment: transactional vs. promotional messages, consent, and responsible treatment of customers in a credit business.

• A habit of checking data before trusting it, and of fixing problems at the root.

• Working expertise in email, SMS and WhatsApp, with modular, localisable content for several markets.

• A habit of using AI to speed up QA and analysis, with the judgment to know when not to trust it.

• High ownership and a bias to action: you’d rather ship something good this week than something perfect next quarter, and you drive conversations with Product, Engineering, Legal and Risk toward decisions.

What can you expect at Bondora?
